findings.title: Unused notes field
findings.description: The `notes` field in CreationBriefRequest is present in the UI and request interface but never used by the engine. Document its intended future use or remove it from the interface.

findings.title: Empty string to undefined pattern
findings.description: Replace `topic || undefined` with explicit checks like `topic.trim() === '' ? undefined : topic` to avoid fragility if empty strings gain semantic meaning.

findings.title: Test documentation mismatch
findings.description: Remove the comment claiming integrity failure tests are 'deferred to integration tests' when no such tests exist.
